title: EvidenceBundle
description: Bounded evidence set passed to grounding and generation. Under resolution-by-retrieval (Section 8-9) this object also carries the confidence signal itself — there is no separate resolver result to consult.

bundle_id.description: Unique ID for this bundle, referenced by GroundedAnswer.evidence_bundle_id.

query_text_segmented.description: The segmented query this bundle was produced for, copied from RetrievalInput for traceability.

resolved_procedure_id.description: The procedure_id that retrieval resolved to. Null when confidence_status is 'low_confidence' (no good match found) — never guess a procedure_id in that case.

top_score.description: Score of the single best-ranked candidate across fused retrieval. Null only if retrieval returned zero candidates.

second_score.description: Score of the runner-up candidate, needed to compute margin. Null if fewer than two candidates were returned.

margin.description: top_score minus second_score. A small margin with a high top_score signals genuine ambiguity between two candidates, not low confidence (Section 9). Null if second_score is null.

confidence_status.description: 'resolved' = high top_score with a clear margin, proceed normally. 'ambiguous' = high top_score but narrow margin, ask 'did you mean X or Y'. 'low_confidence' = top_score itself is below the absolute floor, abstain/ask to rephrase. Thresholds for both cases are tuned empirically (Section 9), not hardcoded.

ambiguous_candidates.description: Populated only when confidence_status is 'ambiguous' — the near-tied candidates to present back to the user for disambiguation. Empty otherwise.

evidence.description: The bounded set of fragments to pass to grounding/generation. Empty when confidence_status is 'low_confidence'.

fusion_method.description: Description/name of the rule used to fuse lexical and dense candidates (Section 8.4).

created_at.description: Timestamp this bundle was produced, for audit and cache invalidation.
